subject: Orchard project: provisioning additional teams & keys (term addendum)
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmecare.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard expansion — additional teams & keys

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call last week. Quick summary from our side: Orchard (our patient intake app) is ready to move from a single sandbox integration to a 3-team rollout in production — Intake, QA, and Billing. High level asks:

- 3 new API keys scoped to the Orchard tenant (one per team)
- Separate rate limits for Billing (higher TPS)
- A short-term increase in reserved capacity for the next 90 days while we ramp
- Minor term tweak: push renewal date out by one quarter so the expansion aligns with our budget cycle

I attached a brief requirements doc. Can Redwood provide an estimated quote and a simple addendum we can sign? We need to get technical access for the teams by Aug 23 to hit our pilot date.

Appreciate any quick guidance — cc'ing Maya (engineering lead) for specifics.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Platform Ops
AcmeCare Health

Attachments: AcmeCare_Orchard_requirements_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmecare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard expansion — additional teams & keys

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the attached doc. We can absolutely support the 3-team rollout and the per-team keys. Proposed next steps from Redwood: 

1) Technical: we will issue 3 scoped API keys (one per team) and a rate-limit profile for Billing. I’ll have Marcus reach out to Maya to confirm expected TPS for Billing so we size reserved capacity correctly.

2) Capacity & timing: we can provision a short 90-day burst pool immediately; we recommend a small reserved add-on for predictable latency during pilot.

3) Commercial: Ben will draft a concise addendum that:
   - extends the renewal date by one quarter,
   - adds the reserved capacity SKU for 90 days, and
   - records the per-key rate-limit tiers.

If that sounds good I’ll put the timeline below and we can get keys out before Aug 23:
- Aug 13: Confirm TPS for Billing (Marcus + Maya)
- Aug 14: Ben sends addendum draft
- Aug 15–16: Internal review & signature
- Aug 18: Keys provisioned & QA access

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the constraints.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
